## Declarations

### NowakiConfig

Interface. `import type { NowakiConfig } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/config";`

```ts
export interface NowakiConfig {
    site?: string;
    fonts?: FontConfig[];
    basePath?: string;
    trailingSlash?: "never" | "always" | "ignore";
    redirects?: RuleList<RedirectRule>;
    rewrites?: RuleList<RewriteRule>;
    headers?: RuleList<HeaderRule>;
    i18n?: I18nConfig;
    images?: ImagesConfig;
    plugins?: (NowakiPlugin | false | null | undefined)[];
}
```

nowaki.config.mjs (or `.js`): the default export. Any other top-level key is an error (with a
"did you mean" hint), so a typo such as `basepath` fails instead of doing nothing.

Members:

- `site`: The site's absolute URL (`https://example.com`), for canonical and Open Graph links,
  sitemap.xml and robots.txt. `NOWAKI_SITE` wins over it at runtime.
- `fonts`: Self-hosted fonts, downloaded or copied at build time (see [`FontConfig`](#fontconfig)).
- `basePath`: Serves the app under a path prefix (`"/app"`). `<Link>`, `href()` and `ctx.redirect` add it.
- `trailingSlash`: `"never"` / `"always"` redirect to the form without / with a trailing slash; `"ignore"` (the
  default) serves both.
- `redirects`: Redirects, checked before routing. A function (possibly async) is called once, when
  `nowaki dev` / `nowaki build` reads the config.
- `rewrites`: Internal rewrites: the request is routed by `destination`, the browser keeps its URL.
- `headers`: Response headers by path. They replace the default security headers of the same name.
- `i18n`: Locales: the default one at `/`, the others under `/<locale>/`.
- `images`: `<Image>` options.
- `plugins`: Build-time plugins (`@nowaki-dev/markdoc`, or your own [`NowakiPlugin`](#nowakiplugin)). A falsy entry is
  skipped, so `cond && plugin()` works.

Example:

```tsx
import { defineConfig } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/config";
export default defineConfig({ site: "https://example.com", basePath: "/app" });
```

Uses: [`FontConfig`](#fontconfig), [`RuleList`](#rulelist), [`RedirectRule`](#redirectrule), [`RewriteRule`](#rewriterule), [`HeaderRule`](#headerrule), [`I18nConfig`](#i18nconfig), [`ImagesConfig`](#imagesconfig), [`NowakiPlugin`](#nowakiplugin).

Used by: [`defineConfig`](#defineconfig).

### RedirectRule

Interface. `import type { RedirectRule } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/config";`

```ts
export interface RedirectRule {
    source: string;
    destination: string;
    permanent?: boolean;
    statusCode?: 301 | 302 | 303 | 307 | 308;
    locale?: boolean;
}
```

A `redirects` entry. `source` is a path pattern (`/blog/[slug]`, `/docs/[...rest]`); a `[param]`
captured there can be used in `destination`. With `i18n`, a rule matches the path without its
locale prefix unless `locale: false`. The same holds for rewrites and header rules.

Members:

- `source`: The path pattern to match.
- `destination`: A path, or an absolute http(s) URL.
- `permanent`: `true`: 308, else 307 (unless `statusCode`).
- `statusCode`: The redirect status; wins over `permanent`.
- `locale`: `false`: match `source` against the path with its locale prefix.

Used by: [`NowakiConfig`](#nowakiconfig).

### I18nConfig

Interface. `import type { I18nConfig } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/config";`

```ts
export interface I18nConfig {
    locales: string[];
    defaultLocale: string;
    prefixDefaultLocale?: boolean;
    detect?: boolean;
}
```

The `i18n` key: the app's locales and how URLs carry them.

Members:

- `locales`: Locale tags (`"en"`, `"pt-BR"`).
- `defaultLocale`: One of `locales`, served without a prefix unless `prefixDefaultLocale`.
- `prefixDefaultLocale`: Serves the default locale under its prefix too (`/en/...`). Default false.
- `detect`: Sends `/` to the visitor's locale (the `nowaki_locale` cookie, then `Accept-Language`).
  Default false.

Used by: [`NowakiConfig`](#nowakiconfig).

### GoogleFont

Interface. `import type { GoogleFont } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/config";`

```ts
export interface GoogleFont extends FontCommon {
    provider: "google";
    weights?: (number | string)[];
    styles?: ("normal" | "italic")[];
    subsets?: string[];
    src?: never;
    weight?: never;
    style?: never;
}
```

Downloaded from Google Fonts at build time and served from the app (pages never call Google).

Members:

- `provider`: Marks a Google font.
- `weights`: The weights to download. Default `[400]`.
- `styles`: Default `["normal"]`.
- `subsets`: Default `["latin"]`. Unnamed slices (CJK families) are always kept.
- `src`: Not allowed on a Google font (a local font's key).
- `weight`: Not allowed on a Google font: use `weights`.
- `style`: Not allowed on a Google font: use `styles`.

Uses: [`FontCommon`](#fontcommon).

Used by: [`FontConfig`](#fontconfig).

```ts
    }[];

```

A font file in the app, copied into the build. Paths are relative to the app root.

Documented members:

- `src`: One file (`"./fonts/brand.ttf"`).
- `weight`: A weight, or a range for a variable font (`"100 900"`). Default 400.
- `style`: Default `"normal"`.
- `src`: One entry per face.

Uses: [`FontCommon`](#fontcommon).

### NowakiPlugin

Interface. `import type { NowakiPlugin } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/config";`

```ts
export interface NowakiPlugin {
    name: string;
    transform?(code: string, id: string): PluginCode | Promise<PluginCode>;
    resolveId?(source: string, importer: string): string | {
        id: string;
    } | null | undefined | Promise<string | {
        id: string;
    } | null | undefined>;
    load?(id: string): PluginCode | Promise<PluginCode>;
}
```

A build-time plugin in `plugins`. The hooks follow Rollup's names and arguments, run in the
plugin host (a Node process `nowaki dev` / `nowaki build` start), and may be async.

Members:

- `name`: Shown in errors.
- `transform`: Rewrites a module's source (`id` is its absolute path). Plugins run in order, each on the
  previous output.
- `resolveId`: Resolves an import specifier to an id (a virtual module, say). The first plugin to return one
  wins.
- `load`: The source of an id (from `resolveId`). The first plugin to return one wins.

Uses: [`PluginCode`](#plugincode).

Used by: [`NowakiConfig`](#nowakiconfig), [`markdoc`](markdoc.md#markdoc).

### FontCommon

Interface, not exported: listed because exported declarations use it.

```ts
interface FontCommon {
    family: string;
    fallback?: "sans-serif" | "serif" | "monospace";
    variable?: string;
    display?: "auto" | "block" | "swap" | "fallback" | "optional";
    preload?: boolean;
}
```

Members:

- `family`: The CSS family name.
- `fallback`: The local fallback whose metrics are adjusted to match. Default `"sans-serif"`.
- `variable`: The custom property holding the font stack. Default `--font-<family>`.
- `display`: `font-display`. Default `"swap"`.
- `preload`: Preloads the latin, upright faces. Default true.

Used by: [`GoogleFont`](#googlefont), [`LocalFont`](#localfont).
